name: zvideo_dd_palette_set_entries
description: zVideo_dd::PaletteSetEntries forwards palette entries to the active DirectDraw palette only in 8-bpp display modes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo palette/DDraw provider pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a9890 validates the zvid_dd.c source file, fastcall firstEntry in CX and entryCount in DX, early return 0 when g_zVideo_DisplayModeBpp is not 8, IDirectDrawPalette::SetEntries call through vtable slot 0x18 with flags 0, zero-extended first entry and count, and the caller-supplied PALETTEENTRY pointer.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a9890 has no warning tags. The only authored direct callee is zVideo_dd::ReportError at tier C or better; IDirectDrawPalette::SetEntries is a DirectDraw provider boundary.

The native smoke uses a fake IDirectDrawPalette provider and verifies the non-8-bpp early return without provider calls, the 8-bpp success path forwarding flags, first entry, count, and entry pointer, and the provider failure path returning 0x5a56ffff after the same SetEntries call contract.
